name: Roach
description: The roach is a widespread freshwater fish from the carp family. It is easily recognizable by its characteristic red iris.
habitat: Roach live in standing and slowly flowing waters. They prefer lakes, ponds and rivers with rich plant growth.
diet: Omnivore - feeds on insect larvae, zooplankton, algae and aquatic plants
conservation: Not endangered - common species in European waters
funFact: Roach are very social fish and live in large schools that can comprise several thousand individuals.
